# ============================================================
# 11 - 閾値アラート（計算結果が閾値超え → Teams に警告カード）
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 税額・償却費などの計算結果が Threshold を超えたときだけ
# attention カードを飛ばす監視型の雛形。範囲内なら good カード。
# 「投稿は閾値超過時だけにしたい」場合は ELSE 側の Body 組み立てと
# POST を IF の中にだけ残せばよい。
# ============================================================
SET ExePath TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc\\fincalc.exe'''
SET WorkDir TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc'''
SET WebhookUrl TO $'''https://example.webhook.office.com/webhookb2/xxxxx'''


SET Threshold TO 3000000
SET Income TO 10000000

# CLI を実行し stdout/stderr/exit code を CliOut/CliErr/CliExit へ格納
Scripting.RunDOSCommand.RunDOSCommand DOSCommandOrApplication: $'''%ExePath% tax corporate --income %Income%''' WorkingDirectory: WorkDir StandardOutput=> CliOut StandardError=> CliErr ExitCode=> CliExit
IF CliExit <> 0 THEN
    # エラーダイアログを出してフロー終了 (IF CliExit <> 0 の中で使う)
    Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''fincalc エラー''' Message: CliErr Icon: Display.Icon.Warning Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 30
    EXIT
END
# stdout の JSON をカスタムオブジェクトへ変換
Variables.ConvertJsonToCustomObject Json: CliOut CustomObject=> Result

DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> Now

IF Result.total > Threshold THEN
    SET Body TO $'''{"type":"message","attachments":[{"contentType":"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive","content":{"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"[ALERT] 法人税概算が閾値超過","weight":"bolder","size":"medium","color":"attention"},{"type":"FactSet","facts":[{"title":"課税所得","value":"%Income% 円"},{"title":"税額合計","value":"%Result.total% 円"},{"title":"閾値","value":"%Threshold% 円"},{"title":"時刻","value":"%Now%"}]},{"type":"Container","style":"attention","items":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"納税資金の手当てを確認してください","wrap":true}]}]}}]}'''
ELSE
    SET Body TO $'''{"type":"message","attachments":[{"contentType":"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive","content":{"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"[OK] 法人税概算は閾値内","weight":"bolder","size":"medium"},{"type":"FactSet","facts":[{"title":"課税所得","value":"%Income% 円"},{"title":"税額合計","value":"%Result.total% 円"},{"title":"閾値","value":"%Threshold% 円"},{"title":"時刻","value":"%Now%"}]},{"type":"Container","style":"good","items":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"正常範囲内です","wrap":true}]}]}}]}'''
END

# Teams Webhook へ Adaptive Card JSON を POST (応答は HTTP 202)
Web.InvokeWebService.InvokeWebService Url: WebhookUrl Method: Web.Method.Post Accept: $'''application/json''' ContentType: $'''application/json''' RequestBody: Body EncodeRequestBody: False TrimRequestBody: True ClearCookies: True FailOnErrorStatus: False FollowRedirection: True UserAgent: $'''Mozilla/5.0''' ConnectionTimeout: 30 AcceptUntrustedCertificates: False Response=> WebResponse ResponseHeaders=> WebHeaders StatusCode=> WebStatus

IF (WebStatus < 200) OR (WebStatus > 299) THEN
    # 警告ダイアログを表示 (Timeout 秒で自動的に閉じる)
    Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''Teams 通知失敗''' Message: $'''HTTP %WebStatus% : %WebResponse%''' Icon: Display.Icon.Warning Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 30
    EXIT
END

# 情報ダイアログを表示 (Timeout 秒で自動的に閉じる)
Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''完了''' Message: $'''閾値判定結果を Teams に投稿しました''' Icon: Display.Icon.Information Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 10
